kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem check-upgrade-item --upgrade-item-id dispose_task_upgrade --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for '113091674488****' --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckUpgradeItem

parameters.help_en: The ID of the upgrade item
parameters.name: upgrade_item_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for threat analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
Note: This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns a 400 error: "The specified Lang can not be empty."
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
注意：此参数实际为必填，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误「The specified Lang can not be empty.」
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

CheckResult.description_en: The check result of the check item. Possible values include OK and FAIL
CheckResult.description_zh: 检查项的检查结果。可能的取值如 OK、FAIL 等

UpgradeItemId.description_en: The ID of the upgrade item
